title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
slides: Is eBay closing its doors to AI agents?
It quietly blocked third-party AI shopping bots.
Sellers relying on those agents lose visibility overnight.
Check if your storefront depends on external agents.
Audit your traffic sources before the next update.
thread_text:
1. eBay Just Went Quiet

Without warning, third-party AI shopping bots stopped seeing eBay listings. Sellers woke up to missing traffic and no explanation.

2. Who's Behind the Block?

eBay hasn't publicly commented, but the pattern suggests a deliberate technical barrier. Bots that scrape or automate purchases are the target.

3. Sellers Left in the Dark

Merchants relying on AI agents for visibility lost their lifeline overnight. No notice, no grace period — just a sudden drop in exposure.

4. Check Your Dependencies

If your storefront depends on external shopping agents, you're exposed. Map every third-party tool that drives traffic to your listings.

5. Audit Before the Next Update

List your top traffic sources today. If any are AI-driven, test a fallback. What's your plan if eBay blocks them next?
